dedupe_keys.name: eirgrid and soni smart grid dashboard downloadable system observations

description: The EirGrid Group Smart Grid Dashboard publishes electricity-system observations for Ireland, Northern Ireland and the combined island. EirGrid, SONI and SEMO provide demand, generation, wind and solar output, interconnector transfers, frequency, imbalance prices and volumes, non-synchronous penetration and carbon indicators. Users can select dates, compare regions and export CSV data. The public documentation specifies five-second frequency observations, thirty-minute trading periods for imbalance measures and fifteen-minute carbon-intensity values; other series and the earliest available dates were not established. Access is free under the EirGrid Group Open Data Licence, which permits commercial and non-commercial reuse with attribution. A limitation is that several values are estimates or forecasts, and the descriptions do not establish a common observation interval or a complete archive for every variable. Provider terms also allow feed throttling and do not guarantee continued supply. Simulation uses include electricity-balance calibration, renewable-integration scenarios and validation of aggregate operating behaviour. No existing catalogue or first-review draft for this dashboard was found. The transmission-map viewer is linked, but its geometry and export availability were not inspected. Coverage is Ireland, Northern Ireland and their combined system.
